name: Sinan Navarro-Afriyie
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Western and Division
description:
Sinan Navarro-Afriyie is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 26, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, he worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. He works as a fixer out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Sinan Navarro-Afriyie describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
psychology.secret: Sinan Navarro-Afriyie sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Sinan Navarro-Afriyie on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Sinan Navarro-Afriyie is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A dead drop Sinan Navarro-Afriyie maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Sinan Navarro-Afriyie is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean — the kind of frame that reads as either ascetic discipline or chronic resource scarcity. Minimal body fat, visible tendon definition in forearms and neck. Efficient rather than muscular.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, natural with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Short, practical cut with slight fade — maintained but not groomed
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertone — natural, no augmentation
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones — the mixed heritage evident in subtle feature asymmetry
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, narrow jaw, slight scar tissue around left eye socket from old trauma. Skin texture weathered but not aged — sun-exposure and environmental stress rather than years. Stubble permanent fixture, grooming functional rather than aesthetic.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from right inner wrist to mid-forearm where smartgun link was installed, chrome visible at entry point
Thin white scar crossing left temple to cheekbone, roughly 3cm
Tattoo on right shoulder blade — geometric circuit pattern in white ink, faded
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right forearm displays chrome smartgun link interface — visible at wrist and mid-forearm as brushed steel panels with subtle LED status indicators. No visible respiratory modifications, but there is a barely-noticeable seam along his ribs where synthetic lung integration occurred.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Slight forward lean when at rest, suggests constant scanning of environment. Right arm carries slightly different tension than left due to chrome weight distribution. Eyes track exits and entry points habitually.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 runner aesthetic. Charcoal synthweave cargo pants with reinforced pockets and concealed weapon rig. Black hooded tech-jacket with integrated temp-regulation — visible wear at collar and cuffs. Neutral colors, practical fabrics, minimal branding. Shoes are worn Yakamaki tactical boots, well-maintained. Wears a discrete wrist-mounted comm unit, older model but reliable.
